Description: Garantir sticky bit em diretórios world writable.

Subtópico: Verificar ownership das homes dos usuários

Auditoria - Script: ( awk -F: '$3>=1000 && $1!="nfsnobody"{print $1,$6}' /etc/passwd | while read -r u h; do [ -d "$h" ] && [ "$(stat -Lc %U "$h")" = "$u" ] || exit 1; done ) && echo "PASS" || echo "FAIL" expect: (?i)^\s*PASS\s*$
